description: This file defines classes related to calculator input handling, including managing numeric input, conversion to string, and rational number representation within the CalcEngine namespace.

classes.name: CalcNumSec
classes.description: Represents a section of a calculator number, managing its string value and sign.

classes.name: CalcInput
classes.description: Handles user input for calculator operations, including digit addition, sign toggling, decimal point management, and conversion to rational numbers.

methods.name: CalcNumSec::Clear
methods.description: Resets the numeric section to an empty state.

methods.name: CalcNumSec::IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the numeric section is empty.

methods.name: CalcNumSec::IsNegative
methods.description: Returns whether the number is negative.

methods.name: CalcNumSec::IsNegative (setter)
methods.description: Sets the negativity of the number.

methods.name: CalcInput::TryToggleSign
methods.description: Attempts to toggle the sign of the current input.

methods.name: CalcInput::TryAddDigit
methods.description: Attempts to add a digit to the current input.

methods.name: CalcInput::TryAddDecimalPt
methods.description: Attempts to add a decimal point.

methods.name: CalcInput::HasDecimalPt
methods.description: Checks if a decimal point has been added.

methods.name: CalcInput::TryBeginExponent
methods.description: Attempts to start an exponent part of the number.

methods.name: CalcInput::SetDecimalSymbol
methods.description: Sets the decimal symbol used in input.

methods.name: CalcInput::IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the input is empty.

methods.name: CalcInput::ToString
methods.description: Converts the current input to a string representation in the specified radix.

methods.name: CalcInput::ToRational
methods.description: Converts the current input to a Rational object with specified radix and precision.
